schema_changes.compatibility: schema_version 1 retained. Optional strict details version 1 emitted by collector. Older reports accepted with limited-selected-provenance review note.
schema_changes.evidence_paths: Canonical printable absolute Linux path labels allow punctuation and Unicode; traversal/control/credential-like labels remain restricted. Local report paths still use discovery._path; unsupported desired field values become unresolved.
schema_changes.details.repositories: Map repository path -> {head: selected .git/HEAD, config: selected .git/config, ref: selected loose-ref path or null}. Fixed selector semantics are documented in validate_details.
schema_changes.details.isaacsim: Map installation path -> {version: selected VERSION path}.
schema_changes.details.environments: Map environment path -> {python: selected Conda python record path or pyvenv.cfg or null, packages: map package name -> selected conda-meta JSON or dist-info METADATA path}.
schema_changes.details.system_packages: Shared status_source and manual_source fixed to declared system_root var/lib/dpkg/status and var/lib/apt/extended_states; status map keyed by name:architecture retains install ok installed / hold ok installed. Base package manual field carries selected Auto-Installed classification or unknown.
schema_changes.details.links: Map encountered selected link path -> {target: bounded lexical target or null, status: recorded or redacted}. Never traverses targets.
schema_changes.details.followups: At most 128 stable SHA256(kind NUL path)[:24] keyed {kind,path,target,records,action:request-explicit-scope}; kinds workspace, isaacsim, repository-metadata, git-worktree, repository-ref, linked-path, environment-descriptors, editable-metadata. Candidate/review notes point to exact retained keys and scope metadata.
schema_changes.details.package_groups: {basis:name-heuristic-review-only, groups:{os-baseline,drivers-cuda,build-tools,optional-applications,uncertain}}. Members are sorted name:architecture identities into raw packages and shared selected-source/status evidence. No native install intent.
schema_changes.bounds: 32 environments, 128 repositories/workspace candidates, 20000 package records and issues; links/followups 128. _finish reserves CLI envelope headroom with <=1MiB raw JSON, emits explicit gaps and prunes orphan source/scope maps after truncation or interruption.
schema_changes.coverage: Explicit unsupported-package-managers and driver-cuda-level-not-collected (no toolkit inference). Existing broad software/editable limitations retained.

limitations: Entirely synthetic sources and versions; no installed health or source availability proof.
Host collection gaps remain in raw report; acceptance here is reviewed intent only.
Dry-run intentionally lacks live target evidence even though fixture paths exist.
Only owned sources/tests modified; no runner, docs, plan, demo, other source, commit or push edits. Source freeze now active.
Only explicit retained bounded fixture runner and exact synthetic CLI demo executed. No real-host inventory/package/GPU/Git/network/managed apply/fixture_builders runs.
Embedded source labels and link targets are data claims validated lexically against declared selected scope, never local read grants or attestation that source contents are genuine.
Relative link targets containing dot/dot-dot or unsupported/control/credential-like strings are redacted unknown; no alternate roots or targets are read.

Package grouping is a deliberately limited name heuristic; manual flags and installed status do not approve installation. Full editable/UV parsing, packed refs, probes, package-manager execution and adoption/sync remain outside scope.

Bounded truncation sacrifices evidence with explicit gaps rather than promising complete inventories. A 1MiB collector raw budget is conservative CLI headroom, not acceptance of arbitrary user-crafted 8MiB evidence envelopes.
Independent final re-review is still the parent workflow; these are implementation and fixture verification receipts, not live-host/security certification.
